# Aero Foundation — aerospace AI research and tool-verified learning

## Pages

- [Aero Foundation — aerospace AI research and tool-verified learning](https://foundation.aerospace-superintelligence.com/): Open aerospace AI research into continued pretraining and reinforcement learning with checkable engineering-tool rewards. Research and design stage; no trained model released.
